title: Claude usage limit jaldi khatam? Limit bachane ke 7 aasan tareeke
description:
Claude usage limit jaldi khatam ho jaati hai? Is video me Claude ki official help pages se 7 aasan tareeke, 3 poore examples ke saath: limit kaise kaam karti hai (5 ghante ka session + weekly limit, Settings me Usage), kaun si cheezein zyada usage khaati hain, aur limit khatam ho jaaye to kya karein.

Chapters:
0:00 Limit beech kaam me khatam?
0:26 Usage limit kaise kaam karti hai
1:05 Kya zyada usage khaata hai
1:33 Tip 1-2: plan + ek message (Example 1)
2:04 Tip 3: saaf aur poora prompt (Example 2)
2:46 Tip 4: Projects aur cache (Example 3)
3:24 Tip 5-6: effort kam, faltu tools band
3:55 Tip 7: lambi chat ki jagah nayi chat
4:22 Limit khatam ho gayi to kya karein
4:50 Recap

Sources (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9797557-usage-limit-best-practices
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11647753-how-do-usage-and-length-limits-work
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects

Short version (5-hour session + weekly limit): https://youtu.be/o93cpNeVYmo
Roz 2 Shorts aur 1 video: Claude Roz Ke Kaam
Agla video: Claude Projects kaise banayein aur use karein, step by step.

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic. Limits can change; always check the Usage page in Settings of your own account.

Note: the Settings, chat and project screens in this video are our own illustrations with example numbers (not a recording). The official page screenshots are our own captures with the key line highlighted. Synthetic voice.
